cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.48%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.05%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: WFRD +8.12%, BE +7.26%, TLN +5.19%, CEG +4.70%, VST +4.40%. Laggards: ENPH -1.57%, LEU -1.50%, EQT -1.20%, EOSE -1.19%.
